title: Settings
demoLabel: Preferences are kept on this device only
soundDesc: Play a sound for new alerts. Not yet connected to a sound player.
criticalOnlyDesc: Hide warnings and show only critical alerts in the alert lists.
deliveryNote: This app does not deliver push notifications, SMS, WhatsApp or background alerts. These switches only change this screen’s preferences.
logoutConfirm: Log out of this demo? Changes made in this session are cleared.

help.title: Help Center
help.p1: Dashboard: counts of your ponds by status. Missing readings are never counted as healthy.
help.p2: Ponds: search, filter and open a pond. Details show each reading and its status.
help.p3: Alerts: active problems and resolved history. Mark as seen records that you have read an alert. It does not resolve the problem.
help.p4: This build shows demo data only. No sensors are connected.

support.title: Contact Support
support.p1: No support channel is configured in this build. Support contact details will be added before release.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1: No privacy policy link is configured in this build. Settings and profile changes are stored only in this app session and are not sent anywhere.
